LESSON: EFFECTS OF BUSINESS TRANSACTIONS

Grade: Grade 10
Subject: BUSINESS STUDIES
Strand: Financial Records in Business
Topic 4.2: Effects of Business Transactions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Effects of Business Transactions, part of Financial Records in Business in Grade 10 BUSINESS STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How do business transactions affect the statement of financial position of a business?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1.  discuss and present on the effects of business transactions on the statement of financial position for a business,  compute the effects of transactions on the statement of financial position for a business,  draw a statement of financial position to determine the net worth of a business after adjustments.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1.  discuss and present on the effects of business transactions on the statement of financial position for a business,  compute the effects of transactions on the statement of financial position for a business,  draw a statement of financial position to determine the net worth of a business after adjustments.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Effects of Business Transactions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Self-efficacy: The learner develops effective communication skills when discussing and presenting on the effects of business

transactions and preparing statements of financial position for businesses.

 Critical thinking and Problem solving: The learner acquires evaluation and decision-making skills when computing the

effects of business transactions on the statement of financial position for businesses.

 Learning to learn: The learner develops skills of working collaboratively when discussing and presenting on effects of

business transactions.

Values:

 Respect: The learner shows regard for the contributions of every member of the team when discussing and presenting on the

effects of business transactions and preparing statements of financial position for businesses.

 Responsibility: The learner performs tasks assigned when computing the effects of business transactions on the statement of

financial position for a business and when drawing a statement of financial position.

 Love: The learner respects others when discussing and presenting on the effects of business transactions on the statement of

financial position for a business.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

 Peer education and Mentorship: The learner enhances inter-personal relationships when discussing and presenting on the

effects of business transactions on the statement of financial position for a business.

 Financial literacy: The learners’ financial skills are enhanced when preparing statement of financial position for a

business.

 Mental health: Emotional awareness is enhanced as the learner discusses and presents on the effects of business

transactions on the statement of financial position for a business.
